summary_1line: Through Vyasa’s grace the dead warriors reunite with living kin for a joyful night, reconcile, then return to their realms as widows join husbands in the Ganges.

image_candidates.scene_text: Pandavas joyfully embrace Karna and their fallen sons among radiant warriors gathered like gods on the banks of the Ganges at night.
At Vyasa’s command, widowed queens step into the sacred Bhagirathi and rise again in celestial forms beside their husbands’ shining chariots.
The assembled dead warriors with banners and chariots vanish in an instant from the riverbank as they depart to the realms of gods and kings.
